[bold] Lore Primer: [/bold]
[bold] (relatively) Early History [/bold]
In 2045, Donald J Trump unfortunately passed. The Trump Organization collapsed. Leftover staff joined together and created Gardens Trust corporation which quickly became a large and powerful corporation that does everything from car repair and grocery stores to CPU chip development and arms weapons dealing. Their power quickly surpassed the governments.
In 2100CE , the first humans colonized Mars in the Sol System. In 2149 CE, humans developed FTL technology. Allowing them to travel the universe. In this new freedom, corporations took over and so began the corporate era. Major corporations - now without laws - began inhumane and cruel slavery. This continued for around 25 years. In 2176 CE the federal governments of the now polluted Earth, in a desperate attempt to combat the corporations, formed into one state known as the United Sol, one true democratic nation. With the new power of the now united nations – they crushed most of the major corporations in a fierce battle. All corporations aside from Gardens Trust.
After the defeat of most of the enemy corporations, the governments each had conflicting values and fell into civil war. In the end, 4 separate entities emerged from United Sol.
New Sol, A democratic federation. The Galactic Union, A communist state. The Freemen. An Anarchist state. The Fourth Order. A militaristic socialist totalitarian
Each faction expanded far into the cosmos. Claiming their own territory.
[bold] Present Day: [/bold]
The year is 2340. A very large black hole anomaly opened 50 years ago, limiting movement across the universe. With the new limited number of space humanity now has to expand, the eyes are set for one sector. An opportunity filled, resource rich sector. The Armstrong sector. All major factions want a piece of the sector.
This is where you are.
The major factions are on the brink of all out war.
